title: Deep underground and into space!
body:
We thought: how can we make Penguin Panic even crazier?
Well, by hiding a brand-new underground level, of course.
And for those who dare to dig deeper… there’s a secret rocket waiting. Where does it go? To space! Yes, our penguin has officially gone intergalactic.

We’ve added new music, polished the menus with a fresh layer of ice, and fixed a bunch of bugs that slipped on the way out.

Download the update and see how far you can go – or how deep you can fall.
